meta.description: Frozen sntrup761 known-answer tests captured from the PQClean C reference implementation.

provenance.rationale: Captured immediately before removal of the C FFI backend (RUSTSEC-2026-0162 / RUSTSEC-2026-0163: PQClean archived). These vectors preserve differential assurance that the pure-Rust backend reproduces the C reference byte-for-byte.
